pages.title: Negentropy Cell
pages.text: A container of order. Inside, entropy flows backwards: heat moves from cold to hot and mixed gases unmix themselves. A Maxwell's demon chip does the sorting and pays for it by erasing its memory elsewhere, as Landauer said it must. The cell is cold and very quiet.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I set a Maxwell's Demon Chip inside a neutronium shell with a Bose-Einstein Condensate in the Maxwell's Demon Sorter. The demon sorted the condensate atoms by speed, and order accumulated inside.

Made in $(item)Maxwell's Demon Sorter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Thermodynamics of Information.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Anomaly Resolution Engine, Arrow of Time Shard, Boltzmann Fluctuation, Entropy Horizon, Inflaton Field, Universe Seed.
